title: "Genotype table"
output: html_document

---

```{r}
# =====================================
# Merge and order HPV genotype tables
# =====================================

# Required libraries
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(openxlsx)

# Correct folder path
folder_path <- "C:/Users/Elizabeth/Desktop/Papers 2025/Paper VPH/secuencias_fasta_genotipos/secuencias_fasta_genotipos"

# List all HPV tables (case-insensitive)
files <- list.files(
  path = folder_path,
  pattern = "^HPV_[0-9]+_latinoamerica_tabla",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

# Safety check
if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("No HPV tables were found. Please check file names and path.")
}

# Read, harmonize, and merge tables
final_table <- lapply(files, function(f) {

  df <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)

  # Force Collection_Date to character if it exists
  if ("Collection_Date" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(Collection_Date = as.character(Collection_Date))
  }

  # Add genotype column from filename
  df %>%
    mutate(
      genotype = gsub(
        "HPV_|_latinoamerica_tabla.*",
        "",
        basename(f),
        ignore.case = TRUE
      )
    )
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

# Order by genotype (numeric ascending)
final_table_ordered <- final_table %>%
  mutate(genotype = as.numeric(genotype)) %>%
  arrange(genotype)

# Output Excel file
output_file <- file.path(
  folder_path,
  "HPV_Latinoamerica_merged_table_ordered.xlsx"
)

# Save Excel
write.xlsx(final_table_ordered, output_file)

# Confirmation
cat("Merged and ordered table successfully saved at:\n", output_file, "\n")
cat("Final table dimensions:", dim(final_table_ordered), "\n")

```
